domain_restrictions: floor(x) is the greatest integer less than or equal to x
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all real numbers x, if m equals floor(x) (the greatest integer less than or equal to x), then x minus m is less than 1.

variables.name: x
variables.role: input to floor function and expression whose difference is bounded

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; floor(x) is a deterministic function of x

statement_nl: For every real number x, x - floor(x) < 1.
